source_title: A combination of herbal formulas, acupuncture, and novel pine-needle stimulation for recurrent alopecia areata
paraphrase_note: Symptoms/tongue/pulse paraphrased by the harness author from the open-access full text; source pattern and principle are the authors' own.
chief_complaint: Sudden patchy hair loss on top of the head (alopecia areata), recurrence after a stressful period at work.
symptoms: sleeps under six hours a night
rage/irritability after months of work stress
tight abdomen with fullness in chest and rib-sides
tongue_as_reported: red tongue body, stasis at the edges, thin yellow coating
pulse_as_reported: wiry/string-like and slippery; sunken and weak at the cubit (rear) position
source_pattern: Liver Qi stagnation with Liver Yang rising
source_treatment_principle: Soothe the Liver and release constraint, calm rising Yang (Kampo: saikokaryukotsuboreito; blood stasis addressed later); acupuncture added

data.wen_inquiry: Chief complaint: Sudden patchy hair loss on top of the head (alopecia areata), recurrence after a stressful period at work. Symptoms: face redness; sleeps under six hours a night; thirst; hot flashes; excessive sweating; rage/irritability after months of work stress; tight abdomen with fullness in chest and rib-sides.
